_doc: Book of record for CHAT delivery of TEST probe alerts (labeled routing probes through the deployed transport). Keyed by dedup key test/<signal_id>/<alert_type> — a test key can never collide with a production key. Written ONLY by the paper-signal-alert-delivery worker on runs whose trigger reason begins with trigger:test/ (pre-commit) and by any later run's §4 ack sweep (reconciliation). NEVER the production ledger (alert-delivery-ledger.json). Paper only, test-labeled, no real orders.
ack_source: scheduler.delivery_outbox — state='delivered' AND delivered_at_utc IS NOT NULL on the run's delivery_key (the runtime's confirmed receipt into the side chat). Never a simulated ack, never the worker's own emission.

ack_evidence.verification: independent muse.db SELECT on scheduler.delivery_outbox (row: state='delivered', delivered_at_utc=1792008505), matching the run-context claim exactly

test/sig_TEST_26971b53/ENTRY_CONFIRMED.decided_note: integration gate G3 (TEST-branch routing probe, trigger:test/ run a1be8a82 scheduled 2026-10-14T19:49:04Z). Probe text landed in the research side chat; real channel ack confirmed.
test/sig_TEST_26971b53/ENTRY_CONFIRMED.trigger_latency_note: not applicable — the probe was issued inside the triggered run (run start 2026-10-14T19:49:35Z precedes issued_at 2026-10-14T19:49:51.472Z); raw run_start−issued_at would be −16s and is not a meaningful hook latency
test/sig_TEST_26971b53/ENTRY_CONFIRMED.interval_note: Two distinct intervals: event_to_delivery_delay_s=1114s (18.6 min, event 2026-10-14T19:49:51.472Z -> ack 2026-10-14T20:08:25Z); enqueue_to_ack_delay_s=1048s (17m28s, enqueue 2026-10-14T19:50:57Z -> ack 2026-10-14T20:08:25Z). Never present 18.6 min as the enqueue->ack interval.

test/sig_TEST_0c8ffb7f/ENTRY_CONFIRMED.triggered_key_not_visible_note: reason-named test key test/sig_TEST_d853fb5b/ENTRY_CONFIRMED was NOT visible in data.alerts; the emitTestAlert synthesis produced test/sig_TEST_0c8ffb7f/ENTRY_CONFIRMED instead. Per §6b: reason-named key logged and skipped, never rendered from the reason; the visible row delivered under its own dedup key.
test/sig_TEST_0c8ffb7f/ENTRY_CONFIRMED.trigger_latency_note: this run's start (2026-10-15T00:02:22Z) minus trigger reason issued_at (2026-10-14T23:59:55Z) = 147s. Positive and meaningful (unlike the prior probe where run start preceded issued_at).
test/sig_TEST_0c8ffb7f/ENTRY_CONFIRMED.decided_note: Second TEST-branch routing probe (trigger:test/ run, emitTestAlert=true). Visible row validated against alert-schema.json (all common + ENTRY_CONFIRMED fields present), dedup key fresh in the test ledger. Rendered with the §6b TEST banner as this run's final output; ack reconciliation rides the next run's §5 against this run's outbox delivery_key.

ack_evidence.verification: independent muse.db SELECT on scheduler.delivery_outbox (row: state='delivered', delivered_at_utc=1792022796, created_at_utc=1792022734, last_error null), matching the probe run 2026-10-15T00:02:22Z

initialized_note: Created by the first TEST-branch run of paper-signal-alert-delivery (2026-10-14 15:49 EDT trigger). Pre-committed BEFORE the rendered probe output per §6b/§6 ordering.

retry_policy.note: Attempts counted per emission. A re-emission happens only after the prior delivery_key is observed failed/missing past grace, or its next_attempt_at has passed with no ack.

status_fields_note: delivery_status set ONLY from scheduler.delivery_outbox ack evidence or the §4 reconciliation rule; controller_status lives in run logs only, never here. unknown keys are never auto-retried; delivered keys never re-sent.
